ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC) staged exfiltration: 7-Zip archive of backup/SQL hoards followed by MEGAcmd or rclone egress
ucs.description: Hunts INC Ransom's signature double-extortion staging pattern — operators inventory the estate with NetScan, archive backup repositories / SQL dumps / Commvault folders with 7-Zip into staging directories (e.g. C:\ProgramData, C:\Users\Public), and then push archives to MEGA.nz via MEGAcmd or to attacker-controlled S3 via rclone before deploying the INC encryptor. The 7zip-then-MEGA/rclone chain on a backup-heavy host is INC's most distinctive pre-encryption fingerprint and has been the prelude to almost every confirmed INC intrusion (Yamaha Motor Philippines, Xerox, Leicester City Council, NH
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zG.exe","WinRAR.exe","Rar.exe") AND (Processes.process="*a *" OR Processes.process="*-mx*" OR Processes.process="*-p*") AND (Processes.process="*Backup*" OR Processes.process="*Commvault*" OR Processes.process="*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*SQL*" OR Processes.process="*.bak" OR Processes.process="*.vmdk" OR Processes.process="*ProgramData*" OR Processes.process="*Users\\Public*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("MEGAcmd.exe","MEGAclient.exe","megasync.exe","rclone.exe","FileZilla.exe","WinSCP.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*mega.nz*","*mega.io*","*rclone*copy*","*rclone*sync*","*--config*") by Processes.dest Processes.process Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process as exfil_cmd process_name as exfil_tool] | join type=inner dest [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest_category="mega.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest="*mega.nz*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*mega.co.nz*" OR All_Traffic.dest="*userstorage.mega.co.nz*") by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest | rename All_Traffic.src as dest] | table firstTime lastTime dest user parent process exfil_tool exfil_cmd | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let Window = 4h;
let ArchiveStage = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("7z.exe","7za.exe","7zg.exe","winrar.exe","rar.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("a ", "-mx", "-p", "-v")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Backup","Commvault","Veeam","SQL",".bak",".vmdk",".vhdx","ProgramData",@"Users\Public",@"Users\Default")
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project StageTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ArchiveTool = FileName, ArchiveCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              StagingParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let ExfilTool = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName in~ ("megacmd.exe","megaclient.exe","megasync.exe","rclone.exe","filezilla.exe","winscp.exe","curl.exe"))
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega.nz","mega.io","mega.co.nz","rclone copy","rclone sync","rclone mount")
    | project ExfilTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, ExfilUser = AccountName,
              ExfilBin = FileName, ExfilCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let ExfilNet = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz","g.api.mega.co.nz","gfs.mega.co.nz")
         or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("megacmd.exe","megaclient.exe","megasync.exe","rclone.exe")
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP,
              NetProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName;
ArchiveStage
| join kind=inner ExfilTool on DeviceId
| where ExfilTime between (StageTime .. StageTime + Window)
| join kind=leftouter ExfilNet on DeviceId
| where isnull(NetTime) or NetTime between (StageTime .. StageTime + Window + 1h)
| project StageTime, ExfilTime, NetTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ArchiveTool, ArchiveCmd, ExfilBin, ExfilCmd, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP
| order by StageTime desc

ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) (@Image:(*\\7z.exe OR *\\7za.exe OR *\\7zG.exe OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\Rar.exe OR *\\MEGAcmd.exe OR *\\MEGAclient.exe OR *\\MEGAsync.exe OR *\\rclone.exe OR *\\7Z.EXE OR *\\WINRAR.EXE OR *\\RCLONE.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*mega.nz* OR *mega.co.nz* OR *"rclone copy"* OR *"rclone sync"* OR *".bak"* OR *".vmdk"* OR *Commvault* OR *Veeam*)) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR NT\ AUTHORITY*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(7z|7za|7zg|winrar|rar|megacmd|megaclient|megasync|rclone)\.exe$/i OR regex("(mega\\.nz|mega\\.co\\.nz|rclone\\s+(copy|sync|mount)|\\.bak|\\.vmdk|Commvault|Veeam)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| StageTool := if(ImageFileName=/\\(7z|7za|7zg|winrar|rar)\.exe$/i, "archive", "exfil")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={
    [count_archive := count(ImageFileName, distinct=true) | where StageTool="archive",
     count_exfil := count(ImageFileName, distinct=true) | where StageTool="exfil",
     first := min(@timestamp),
     last := max(@timestamp),
     archive_cmd := collect([CommandLine]) | where StageTool="archive",
     exfil_cmd := collect([CommandLine]) | where StageTool="exfil"]
  })
| count_archive >= 1
| count_exfil >= 1
| windowMs := (last - first)
| windowMs <= 14400000
ucs.rationale: INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC, tracked alongside Lynx as suspected successor) consistently couples 7-Zip archiving of backup repositories (Commvault, Veeam, .bak/.vmdk hoards) with MEGAcmd/MEGAsync or rclone exfiltration in the 24-72h before deployment. The double-extortion staging chain — high-entropy archive of backup-adjacent paths followed within 4 hours by an outbound to mega.nz/userstorage.mega.co.

ucs.title: [LLM] INC Ransom lateral pivot: PsExec / WMIC remote service install delivering INC encryptor (-file / -ens / -lhd flags)
ucs.description: Hunts INC Ransom's documented deployment pattern of pushing the encryptor binary across SMB ADMIN$ shares with PsExec or WMIC after RDP-based lateral movement, then invoking it with INC's signature command-line flags (`--file`, `--dir`, `--lhd` for local-hidden-drives, `--ens` for ESXi noSnapshot, `--motd` for VMware MOTD wipe). Combines the classic SMB.exe / wmic.exe process-create pattern with INC-specific argument fingerprints documented in SentinelOne, Huntress and Cybereason reporting.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("psexec.exe","psexec64.exe","paexec.exe","csexec.exe","wmic.exe") OR Processes.process IN ("*\\\\*\\admin$*","*\\\\*\\c$*","*process call create*","*/node:*")) AND (Processes.process="*--file*" OR Processes.process="*--dir*" OR Processes.process="*--lhd*" OR Processes.process="*--ens*" OR Processes.process="*--motd*" OR Processes.process="*--debug*" OR Processes.process="*-file *" OR Processes.process="*-dir *" OR Processes.process="*-lhd*" OR Processes.process="*-ens*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process_name as deploy_tool | append [| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path values(Filesystem.process_name) as writer from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\admin$\\*.exe" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\c$\\*.exe" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Windows\\Temp\\*.exe" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*.exe") AND Filesystem.process_name IN ("System","psexesvc.exe","WmiPrvSE.exe") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename file_path as dropped_file] | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(cmdline) as cmdline values(deploy_tool) as deploy_tool values(dropped_file) as dropped_file values(user) as user by dest | where isnotnull(deploy_tool) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let IncFlags = dynamic(["--file","--dir","--lhd","--ens","--motd","--debug","--vm","-file ","-dir ","-lhd ","-ens "]);
let RemoteDeploy = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("psexec.exe","psexec64.exe","paexec.exe","csexec.exe","wmic.exe","psexesvc.exe")
         or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("psexec.exe","psexesvc.exe","wmic.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\admin$", @"\c$", "process call create", "/node:", "-accepteula")
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any (IncFlags)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project DeployTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              DeployTool = FileName, DeployCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              DeployParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              IsRemoteSession = IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession;
let RemoteExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("psexesvc.exe","wmiprvse.exe","services.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (IncFlags)
         or (FolderPath has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\Users\Public\")
             and FileSize between (100000 .. 5000000))
    | project EncryptTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              EncryptorPath = FolderPath, EncryptorName = FileName,
              EncryptorCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              EncryptorParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EncryptorSHA256 = SHA256;
let RansomDrop = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where FileName matches regex @"(?i)(INC-README|INC_README)\.(txt|html)" 
         or FileName endswith ".INC"
         or FolderPath has_any (@"\admin$\", @"\c$\")
    | project NoteTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              RansomNote = FileName, RansomPath = FolderPath,
              RansomWriter = InitiatingProcessFileName;
RemoteDeploy
| join kind=inner RemoteExec on DeviceId
| where EncryptTime between (DeployTime .. DeployTime + 30m)
| join kind=leftouter RansomDrop on DeviceId
| project DeployTime, EncryptTime, NoteTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          DeployTool, DeployCmd, EncryptorName, EncryptorCmd, EncryptorSHA256,
          RansomNote, IsRemoteSession
| order by DeployTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let IncFlags = dynamic(["--file","--dir","--lhd","--ens","--motd","--debug","--vm","-file ","-dir ","-lhd ","-ens "]);
let RemoteDeploy = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("psexec.exe","psexec64.exe","paexec.exe","csexec.exe","wmic.exe","PSEXESVC.exe")
         or ParentProcessName has_any ("psexec.exe","PSEXESVC.exe","wmic.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any (@"\admin$", @"\c$", "process call create", "/node:", "-accepteula")
         or CommandLine has_any (IncFlags)
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | project DeployTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, IpAddress,
              DeployTool = NewProcessName, DeployCmd = CommandLine, DeployParent = ParentProcessName;
let RemoteExec = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where ParentProcessName has_any ("PSEXESVC.exe","WmiPrvSE.exe","services.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any (IncFlags)
         or NewProcessName has_any (@"\Windows\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\PerfLogs\", @"\Users\Public\")
    | project EncryptTime = TimeGenerated, Computer,
              EncryptorName = NewProcessName, EncryptorCmd = CommandLine, EncryptorParent = ParentProcessName;
let RansomDrop = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed")
    | where TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)(INC-README|INC_README)\.(txt|html)"
         or TargetFileName endswith ".INC"
    | project NoteTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, RansomNote = TargetFileName, RansomPath = TargetFilePath;
RemoteDeploy
| join kind=inner (RemoteExec) on Computer
| where EncryptTime between (DeployTime .. DeployTime + 30m)
| join kind=leftouter (RansomDrop | project-rename Computer = DvcHostname) on Computer
| project DeployTime, EncryptTime, NoteTime, Computer, TargetUserName, IpAddress,
          DeployTool, DeployCmd, EncryptorName, EncryptorCmd, RansomNote
| order by DeployTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: INC Ransom Encryptor Execution via PsExec/WMIC with Signature Flags
id: 8c7b3a14-9d2e-4f1c-a3b5-1e2f7a9c4d6b
status: experimental
description: Detects INC Ransom (GOLD IONIC) encryptor launched remotely via PsExec or WMIC with the documented --file/--dir/--lhd/--ens command-line flags.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1032/
  - https://www.sentinelone.com/labs/inc-ransom-the-inside-story
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.t1569.002
  - attack.t1021.002
  - attack.g1032
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\PSEXESVC.exe'
      - '\wmiprvse.exe'
      - '\services.exe'
  selection_flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' --file '
      - ' --dir '
      - ' --lhd'
      - ' --ens'
      - ' --motd'
      - ' --debug'
      - ' -file '
      - ' -dir '
      - ' -lhd '
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\PerfLogs\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
  condition: selection_parent and (selection_flags or selection_path)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate remote administration tooling using --file/--dir flags from these spawn paths (rare)
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) (@ParentImage:(*\\PSEXESVC.exe OR *\\psexesvc.exe OR *\\WmiPrvSE.exe OR *\\wmiprvse.exe OR *\\services.exe) OR @Image:(*\\PsExec.exe OR *\\PsExec64.exe OR *\\psexec.exe OR *\\paexec.exe OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe)) AND (@CommandLine:(*" --file "* OR *" --dir "* OR *" --lhd"* OR *" --ens"* OR *" --motd"* OR *" -file "* OR *" -dir "* OR *\\admin$\\* OR *\\ADMIN$\\* OR *"process call create"* OR *"/node:"*) OR @Image:(*\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(PSEXESVC|psexesvc|WmiPrvSE|wmiprvse|services)\.exe$/i OR ImageFileName=/\\(PsExec|PsExec64|paexec|csexec|wmic)\.exe$/i
| regex("(--file |--dir |--lhd|--ens|--motd|--debug|-file |-dir |-lhd |\\\\admin\\$|\\\\c\\$|process call create|/node:)", field=CommandLine) OR ImageFileName=/\\(Windows\\Temp|ProgramData|PerfLogs|Users\\Public)\\[^\\]+\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten | TargetFileName=/(INC[-_]README\.(txt|html)|\.INC$)/i | select([aid, TargetFileName, @timestamp])}, field=aid, include=[TargetFileName], mode=left)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName], function={
    [first := min(@timestamp),
     last := max(@timestamp),
     cmd := collect([CommandLine]),
     ransom := collect([TargetFileName])]
  })
ucs.rationale: The combination of PSEXESVC/WmiPrvSE parents spawning binaries from non-standard staging paths (Windows\Temp, ProgramData, PerfLogs, Users\Public) with the INC encryptor's hard-coded flag set (--file, --dir, --lhd, --ens, --motd) is documented across SentinelOne, Cybereason, Huntress and SOCRadar reporting and is unique to INC Ransom / GOLD IONIC (and its suspected Lynx successor).
